style: High-resolution 2.5D pixel art game sprite: clearly visible square pixels on one consistent grid (crisp uniform square art pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur), rich but limited palette, volumetric 3D-like lighting rendered with pixel shading ramps (soft light from above, darker underside, subtle cool rim light), dark one-pixel outline, natural proportions. Pure side view (profile), subject facing RIGHT, single subject centered with about 8% empty margin, transparent background, no text, no border, no ground shadow, no scenery, no water, no bubbles. Original design, not copied from any existing game.
creatureStyle: Mascot-style game character of this real marine species: slightly chibi proportions, an eye 2-3x larger than real with a white pixel highlight, a clear facial expression with personality, simplified chunky shapes, bold readable markings. Still unmistakably the real species (true silhouette, fin placement, markings and colors) and not a fantasy monster: no horns, armor, extra limbs, magic glow or invented parts.
objectStyle: Realistic object rendered as a game item, no face, no eyes.

sprites.prompt: female recreational scuba diver in accurate, realistic scuba gear: full-length black neoprene wetsuit with orange accent panels, black neoprene hood; a low-volume diving mask whose lens is opaque reflective blue-tinted glass so the eyes are NOT visible at all (just a light glare highlight on the lens); second-stage regulator in her mouth with its black hose running over the shoulder to the first stage on the tank valve; a black jacket-style BCD buoyancy vest with chest strap, buckles and an inflator hose; one silver aluminium scuba cylinder strapped on her back; a small yellow octopus backup regulator and a pressure gauge console clipped to the vest; a weight belt with lead blocks; long yellow open-heel fins with black straps. Swimming horizontally underwater in proper diving trim, body stretched out, head on the right, arms forward, empty hands. Face in chunky pixel-art sprite style with very few pixels and flat skin tone; only the lower face is visible under the mask
